description: A 13-vertex tree with positive integer edge weights whose 78 pairwise distances are distinct, with maximum 110. Obtained by appending the leaf 9--12 of weight 69 to the 12-vertex witness of maximum distance 78 recorded in variants/RESULTS.md.
verification: Checked by two independent computations: a traversal from every vertex, and a lowest-common-ancestor path sum from a rooted parent array. Both give the same 78 values; all are distinct and positive.
note: An earlier run of this project recorded M(13) <= 105 by appending a leaf of weight 62 to a 12-vertex witness of maximum distance 79. That witness was not archived and could not be recovered, so the bound 105 is withdrawn and only the exhibited bound 110 is claimed.
